name: maid-bighead-v1

patches.purpose: reserve top 128 stack bytes for runtime state

features.typing: keys keep a small pink maid flying all over the screen (240px/s sideways, 150px/s up/down, rounded turns at all four edges); each key of a run gives full power for 1.5x the recent inter-key gap + 40ms (150..650ms); when a key is overdue gravity takes over: falls, bounces, slides to a stop
features.effects: a trail of pink hearts behind her at speed, a heart floating up off her head on every key, little hearts at take-off and touchdown, squash and stretch
features.gif_player: while the overlay owns the screen the stock GIF player is held in its wait state (its due time at 0x2003EDF0 is kept 500ms ahead)
features.frame_rate: physics in fixed 1/60s steps, one per frame; while she moves only the changed rectangle is sent, full 49ms frames only at rest (every 250ms)
features.requires: a 320x172 full-screen GIF playing on the screen (the overlay paints over GIF frames)
features.enable: first key press after power-on (RAM flag)
features.host: none: no USB protocol, no host program

limitations: Same hook sites and frame pipeline as a build that ran at 60fps on hardware, but this exact image has not been flashed yet
Holding the GIF player writes one word of stock RAM (0x2003EDF0) every main-loop pass
Reserved 128 bytes reduces original available stack
